vulnerability_analysis: The setVault() function in VaultOwned contract lacks zero address validation. When the owner sets vault to address(0), the onlyVault modifier will reject all calls since no caller can be address(0). This permanently disables the mint() function, causing a denial-of-service attack on the token's minting capability.
attack_strategy: Impersonate the contract owner and call setVault(address(0)) to break the mint functionality. Verify the vault is set to zero address and demonstrate that minting fails.
step_by_step_plan:
1. Get the current owner of the SapToken contract
2. Impersonate the owner using vm.prank()
3. Call setVault(address(0)) on the SapToken contract
4. Verify vault() returns address(0)
5. Attempt to mint tokens to show it reverts
